verdict.rationale: Qapita is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. None of the evidence pack's items mention telemetry, analytics, tracking controls or any opt-out mechanism; they cover only cap table, ESOP, valuation and fund-admin features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
